name: Eclipse

passive_description.localized:
Increases wearer's ATK by <lv>{0}</>. Unlocks Arc: Eclipse.
Arc: Eclipse — The wearer creates a <lv>{1}</>s Eclipse. During the Eclipse, each enemy defeated restores <lv>{2}</> Ultimate Energy, up to <lv>{3}</> times. (cooldown: <lv>{4}</>s).
passive_description.source:
装备者的攻击力提升<lv>{0}</>，可使用调弧·「日蚀」。
调弧·「日蚀」：装备者可暂时利用日蚀的能力创造一场持续<lv>{1}</>秒的日蚀。在日蚀持续期间，装备者每击杀一名敌方单位可恢复<lv>{2}</>点终结能量，持续时间内最多触发<lv>{3}</>次。(冷却时间<lv>{4}</>秒)。

tested_hypotheses: The buff_rishi_AtkUp percentage is unconditional and joins the live base-ATK-scaled ATK sum (ATK_static + base_atk * p), never multiplying compiled static ATK (COMBAT_FORMULA_CONTRACT sections 1-2).

The staged atk_percent modifier is delivered by the live hit path (simulation/hit/calculation.rs adds base_atk * atk_percent), executed through the real gear dispatch in tests; runtime_execution_validated stays true with that precise scope.

The Arc: Eclipse curves (buff_rishi_CD2, buff_rishi_energy, buff_rishi_stack, buff_rishi_CD) are observed for unit-hint pinning but never projected or consumed; Eclipse field creation, enemy-defeat energy restoration and the arc cooldown are not modeled.

There is no exclusive character in frozen data: ExclusiveCharacterIDArray is empty and ExclusiveDesc has no string, so wearer legality follows ApplyGroupType ONE plus the weapon-id binding; cross-group wearers and foreign weapons are rejected.
Frozen package evidence does not establish Global release availability.
